verdict.rationale: Decagon is an enterprise customer-support AI platform aimed at businesses, not individual AI-native end users; there is no evidence of a user-facing data export feature in open formats or any account-portability mechanism for end users to 'leave' with their data. The only related mentions are vague 'data portability and control' phrasing for enterprise systems of record, not a concrete open-format export capability. Missing for 10: any documented export functionality, open format specification, or user-initiated data-export/leave workflow.
